vacancyList.postName: Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, HP
Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Dept. of Medical Education & Research, HP

howToApply: Visit the official website https://hprca.hp.gov.in and click ‘Sign Up’ to create a username and password.

Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), and uploading a recent photograph, signature, and supporting documents.
Complete/update your profile before applying for any post.
Log in and click ‘Apply’ against the post of Radiographer (Job Trainee) (Post Code: 26061).
Select your preferred exam district from the dropdown menu.
Review the auto-filled application details from your profile.
Pay the application fee online via Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking through the payment gateway.
Submit the application. Download and save the confirmation for future reference.
Bring the downloaded copy of the online application form along with original certificates and self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification.

howToApply: Register on the HPRCA portal at https://hprca.hp.gov.in by clicking ‘Sign Up’ to create a username and password.

Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading a recent photograph and signature, and uploading relevant supporting documents.
Complete/Update your profile. Only users who have completed their profile can apply for posts.
Apply for the desired post by clicking the ‘Apply’ button corresponding to the post on the HPRCA portal.
Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu.
Review and confirm application details auto-filled from your profile.
Pay the application fee through the available online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking).
After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Download the application form for future reference.

dates.event: Last Date to Apply & Pay Examination Fee

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

title: HPPSC Recruitment 2026 – Scientific Officer, Group-B (Job Trainee) Posts
shortInfo: HPPSC has announced notification for Scientific Officer, Group-B (Job Trainee) posts. Required qualification: M.Sc. in Forensic Science, Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Pharmacy, M.S.(Pharm.), M.Pharm.. Last date to apply: 03-11-26.

fees.category: All Candidates (irrespective of category or gender)

howToApply: Visit the official website of HPPSC at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the link ‘Apply Online’ on the Home Page.
Click on ‘One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations’ and register/create your profile by clicking ‘New Registration’ if not already registered.
Log into your OTR account and select the relevant advertisement from the dashboard.
Fill in all required details carefully in the Online Recruitment Application (ORA).
Upload all requisite documents including Matriculation certificate, degree certificates, experience certificates, category certificates, and Bonafide Himachali certificate as applicable.
Give an undertaking/declaration that uploaded documents are legible and true.
Pay the examination fee of Rs. 600/- through online mode (Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI or any other online digital mode) on or before 03/11/2026 by 11:59 PM.
Submit the application. No corrections/modifications will be allowed after submission.
Download and save the application for future reference.
